helptext.en:
Full Address

Where it is convenient, this can be used to record the full address. This can be used to aid migration from legacy systems with less sophisticated recording practice

Address Parts

To better represent the complexity of addresses each constituent part has been modelled.

Building Name

Use to record the actual name of a building where known.

Building Number

Use to record the number(s) assigned to a building. This may be a single number (eg. 45) or a range separated by a '-' (eg. 13-21).

description.en:
Used to record complex human-made, or human conceived, sites, areas or landscapes. Areas can be anything from a simple prehistoric settlement site (evidenced by a few flint-working fragments) to large-scale, urban conservation areas incorporating multiple assets within a city. The use of Area or Monument will be a question of granularity.

For building complexes such as castles, prisons and airfields, Area may be used to record the footprint of the site, eg. the curtain wall and outer defences of a castle. This Area can then be used as the parent for multiple Monument records.
